commands:
for f in $(git ls-tree -r --name-only 5fa98b63d4ae8b6060fff20f5ce223506d2623eb -- skills/create-issue/); do
  git show 5fa98b63d4ae8b6060fff20f5ce223506d2623eb:"$f" 2>/dev/null | grep -nE "sub-step [0-9]|sub-steps [0-9]|Step 4 sub-step|approval election|final-byte trigger.*approval|self-assignment election" | sed "s|^|$f:|"
done | grep -v "step-4-present-create.md\|step-3-6-audit.md\|issue-template.md\|SKILL.md\|fallback-audit-boundary-offer.md"

for f in degradation-routing fallback-state-owner-unavailable fallback-draft-write-recovery step-3-5-steelman revision-delta fallback-audit-dispatch-arms fallback-audit-evidence-degraded fallback-implement-offer-tier-read; do echo "=== $f ==="; git show 5fa98b63d4ae8b6060fff20f5ce223506d2623eb:skills/create-issue/references/$f.md | grep -nE "sub-step [0-9]|Step 4 sub-step|approval election|final-byte trigger|self-assignment" ; done

for f in skills/create-issue/SKILL.md skills/create-issue/references/step-4-present-create.md skills/create-issue/references/step-3-6-audit.md skills/create-issue/references/issue-template.md skills/create-issue/references/fallback-audit-boundary-offer.md; do echo "=== $f ==="; git show 5fa98b63d4ae8b6060fff20f5ce223506d2623eb:$f | grep -nE "sub-step [0-9]+[a-c]?|Step 4 (sub-step|[0-9])|sub-step 4|sub-step 5" ; done

scrub.shapes: GitHub tokens/PATs, Anthropic keys, Bearer Authorization headers, and basic Authorization headers
